easy_fields.name: Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS) dataset
easy_fields.creator: Vineel Pratap, Qiantong Xu, Anuroop Sriram, Gabriel Synnaeve, Ronan Collobert
easy_fields.citeAs: Vineel Pratap, Qiantong Xu, Anuroop Sriram, Gabriel Synnaeve, Ronan Collobert. MLS: A LARGE-SCALE MULTILINGUAL DATASET FOR SPEECH RESEARCH. A PREPRINT, December 22, 2020.
easy_fields.description: Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS) is a large multilingual corpus for speech research, derived from read audiobooks from LibriVox. It consists of 8 languages, including about 44.5K hours of English and a total of about 6K hours for other languages. The dataset also provides Language Models (LM) and baseline Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models for all included languages.
